text_block_list.text:
The autumn Tenno Sho is drawing near,
and
attention starts to focus on the
showdown
between Нарита Брайан and
Oguri Cap.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Огури Кэп makes it clear that she won't
relinquish
victory, while Нарита Брайан
quietly ignites her own
competitive
spirit.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Бива Хаяхидэ learns that
Narita
Brian is aiming for the Senior
Autumn Triple
Crown.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She's holding out hope that she'll be
able to make
it in time for year's end.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
